capabilities: Split note content by h1 or h2 headings into one image per section
Render pages with preset templates and custom themes controlling colors, fonts, and spacing
Preview rendering live while editing, with a lock to prevent refreshes
Customize avatar, nickname, and footer text
Export the current page or all pages as images
disambiguation: RED here means the Chinese social platform Xiaohongshu, not the color or a markdown linter.
extras: Interface is available only in Simplified Chinese. The README includes donation links (Buy Me a Coffee, WeChat Pay, Alipay).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into styled, shareable images for social platforms like Xiaohongshu.
summary: Converts Markdown notes into Xiaohongshu (RED) style card images, splitting content by heading level into one image per section.
